about.lead: Étal is a portfolio project: the full redesign of an e-commerce application, built like a real product, with no real sales.

project.title: The project
project.text: A beauty, fashion and home shop presented like a magazine: a filterable catalogue, a persistent cart, a three-step checkout, a customer area and a full back office. The data comes from the public DummyJSON API, which simulates every write.

architecture.title: Architecture
architecture.text: The browser never talks to the API directly: every call goes through Nitro server routes, which validate inputs with Zod, cache the catalogue and convert prices. An adapter isolates DummyJSON, so switching providers touches a single folder.

security.title: Security
security.text: The session is sealed in an httpOnly cookie; the API tokens stay on the server and refresh automatically. Back-office routes check the role on the server, not only in the interface.

quality.title: Quality
quality.text: Strict TypeScript, ESLint and Prettier, unit and component tests with Vitest, end-to-end journeys and accessibility audits with Playwright and axe, continuous integration on GitHub Actions.

demo.title: Try the demo
demo.text: The sign-in page offers two demo accounts: a customer and an administrator.

faq.lead: Everything you need to know about this demo shop.

order.question: Can I really place an order?
order.answer: No. Étal is a portfolio project: the checkout goes all the way to the confirmation, but nothing is shipped and no payment is taken.

payment.question: Which card should I use?
payment.answer: Only the test card offered on the payment step is accepted. Real card numbers are neither accepted nor sent.

promo.question: Is there a promo code?
promo.answer: Yes: {code} takes {percent}% off the subtotal; enter it in the cart.

shipping.question: How is delivery calculated?
shipping.answer: Standard and pickup-point delivery are free from {threshold}; express delivery is always charged. The delivery times shown are fictitious.

account.question: How do I sign in?
account.answer: Use one of the demo accounts shown on the sign-in page, or create an account: it is created in demo mode and not kept on the server.

cart.question: Is my cart kept?
cart.answer: Yes, in your browser: it survives a page reload, as do your favourites and your demo orders.

admin.question: What can I do in the back office?
admin.answer: With the administrator account: manage products, users and orders. The API simulates every change; nothing is saved, and “Reset the demo” starts over.

prices.question: Why are prices in euros?
prices.answer: The API prices are in US dollars. They are converted at a fixed rate into a single, configurable currency: euros by default, CFA francs as an option.

data.title: Personal data
data.text: No personal data is collected or sold. The forms (sign-up, newsletter, payment) send nothing to third parties; demo accounts and orders come from DummyJSON.

storage.title: Cookies and local storage
storage.text: Only technical cookies are used: the sign-in session (httpOnly, encrypted), the theme, the language and the back-office sidebar state. The cart, favourites and demo orders stay in your browser’s local storage. No advertising or analytics cookies.
